messages:
amanda: Windows users hitting SmartScreen on the new redwoodctl installer; blocks install and then localtest fails to pick up profile token. Anyone seen this?
rajiv: yep saw one in analytics this morning. Device blocked, user clicked 'don't run' and token never persisted.
sylvie: do we sign the installer with EV cert? SmartScreen usually needs reputation or EV.
kevin: we code-sign with standard cert but not EV. Need reputation build-up or EV purchase. But can we surfaround? maybe fallback to a 'portable' zip?
amanda: the failure cascades: installer partially runs, creates %APPDATA%/redwood/profile.json but perms are wrong -> localtest can't read -> redwoodctl login falls into retry loop.
rajiv: can you paste the log?
amanda: here's the localtest log snippet:
```
ERROR redwoodctl: failed to read token: open C:\Users\Amanda\AppData\Roaming\redwood\profile.json: access denied
2024-03-05T12:04:02Z retrying auth (attempt 3)
```
sylvie: hmm perms look like installer ran as system? maybe our NSIS script sets wrong owner when elevated.
kevin: we also saw race when docker containers mount the host path during localtest -> token file gets locked briefly.
amanda: @rajiv any chance we can patch installer to create profile with 0600 and current user owner?
rajiv: yes patchable. Also we should add a check in postinstall that verifies token read/writable and surface clear message instead of silent retry.
sylvie: for immediate workaround add to docs: `redwoodctl localtest --config-dir C:\Users\<you>\.redwood` or run installer with 'Run anyway' to avoid partial state
kevin: :thumbsup: also adding small retry-backoff would avoid tight-loop spam.
devex-bot: Created GH issue: #4082 'Windows installer: SmartScreen block leads to profile permission/race causing login retry loop' assigned to @rajiv
amanda: thanks. I'll add a quick FAQ in onboarding sample-app about 'SmartScreen' and portable zip option.
rajiv: I'll draft installer PR + postinstall validation, target a patch this week.
sylvie: ping me for QA on Windows + localtest docker scenarios.
amanda: cool, closing the loop for now. anyone else hit this on mac/wsl?
kevin: separate issue but we've got wsl stray symlink problems tracked elsewhere.
